column3: MT 63:19b. NKJV renders the conditional “if You tore” as a wish, “Oh, that You would rend the heavens!”
MT 64:1. Close to the Hebrew; “quake” is rendered “tremble.”
MT 64:3. Close to the Hebrew; “from long ago” is rendered “since the beginning of the world.”
MT 64:4. The Hebrew is obscure; NKJV renders “in them long duration, so we may be saved?” as “In these ways we continue; And we need to be saved.”
MT 64:5. Close to the Hebrew; “a garment of menstruation” is rendered “filthy rags.”
MT 64:6. Close to the Hebrew; “melted us in the hand of” is rendered “consumed us because of.”
MT 64:7. Close to the Hebrew; “the one who formed us” is rendered “our potter.”
MT 64:8. Close to the Hebrew; “up to muchness” is rendered “furious.”
MT 64:10. Close to the Hebrew; “house of holiness and splendor” is rendered “holy and beautiful temple.”
